prompts.prompt: Use case: identity-preserve. Asset type: six-frame decomposition-to-bones spritesheet for the chopped Zombie death variant. Edit target: attached 3x2 fall sheet. Use ONLY the BOTTOM RIGHT final resting pose as the exact source for all six frames. Preserve that pose's detailed pixel-art style, scale, all pieces' positions and grounded contact. IMPORTANT: the body is HEADLESS and has only ONE arm attached. Its SEPARATE head lies to the LEFT of the neck, and its SEVERED arm lies LIMP ON THE GROUND beside the foot at the RIGHT. The detached arm must NEVER float above the leg, and neither head nor arm may ever reattach/regrow. All SIX frames show these same three pieces resting motionless in exactly the same positions. Canvas1536x1024 transparent RGBA,3columns x2rows,512x512cells, at least30px margins. Within eachcell corpse/pieces extend approximately x45..470, y280..390, belt atx255, groundbaseliney390. Match source anatomical scale (standing size about350px). Frame1: exact final fully fleshed dismembered corpse with red floor splatter, separated head and arm already lying on ground. Frame2: skin and clothing begin dissolving, blood fading, hints of bone visible. Frame3: half flesh/cloth vanished; detached skull and detached arm bones emerge, neck still headless. Frame4: mostly skeleton and fading cloth/blood. Frame5: completely ivory skeleton, skull detached LEFT, only ONE arm connected to torso, OTHER arm bones lying detached directly on the ground beside the foot RIGHT, leg bones intact. Frame6: same motionless dismembered skeleton, NO blood or skin or clothing. No movement, no shifting pieces, no new limbs, no organs or additional injuries. Keep the detached hand and arm physically resting on the floor alongside the foot in EVERY frame including the final bone poses. Consistent aged ivory palette; no text, grid lines, shadows or background glow. Empty transparent alpha outside the sprite.

Correct the anatomy of this SIX-frame Zombie decomposition sheet while preserving its3x2 layout, transparent background, palette and pixel-art style. The last bone poses accidentally lost the legs and made an arm look connected to the pelvis. There must be a COMPLETE headless HUMAN skeleton torso with BOTH complete LEGS and feet, one arm attached at the shoulder, plus a SEPARATE detached skull LEFT and a SEPARATE severed arm on the GROUND beside the right foot. In ALL frames, preserve/reveal both legs extending from the pelvis toward the right: two femurs, two knees, two lower legs with tibia/fibula, two ankle/FOOT bone shapes at the far right. NO hands attached to the pelvis or legs. The detached arm is an ADDITIONAL piece lying horizontally BELOW/beside the shins and foot on the ground: upper arm bone, elbow, forearm bones, wrist and five-finger hand, disconnected from the torso and legs, limp and grounded with no floating gap. Layout per512x512cell: detached skull x40..110, headless torso/ribcage x130..255, pelvis x255..290, BOTH legs x290..455, foot bones x455..475; detached arm x330..475 andy395..425 beside/below the feet. One attached arm still lies alongside torso in foreground x180..300. All pieces on shared groundy425, same scale in everyframe. Frame1 fleshed clothed corpse with BOTH legs and bare feet intact plus detached arm next to feet; frames2-4 dissolve flesh/cloth/blood to bones; frames5-6 complete headless skeleton with BOTH LEGS AND FEET, separate skull and separate severed arm. Skull and detached arm MUST NOT reattach/regrow. Same six-stage dissolution, no new injuries. Body size same as source, fully contained cells with30pxtransparent margins, canvas1536x1024. Make the final pose anatomically clear and readable: TWO feet at the leg ends, and a separate HAND on the ground beside them.

Edit this pixel-art zombie decomposition sprite sheet. Keep exactly the same six poses and anatomy in a 3-column by 2-row grid of 512 by 512 cells on a 1536 by 1024 transparent canvas. Each pose must fit entirely within its own cell. Scale down every pose uniformly to 84% of its current size, centered within its own cell, leaving at least 35 clear transparent pixels on every side. Do not let any finger, toe, blood or skull cross a cell boundary. In every pose the detached arm and its hand lie flat ON THE GROUND beside the zombie's feet, with the hand supported on the same floor as the attached arm, never suspended above it. Preserve the separate skull to the left, torso at center, pelvis and TWO complete legs with feet extending right, attached arm foreground and the detached second arm beside feet. Keep consistent anatomy and size throughout all six poses. Progress from freshly severed corpse to bare bones. In the final two bone poses, remove red bleeding cut stumps and make clean ivory bones, while a small static red stain can remain on the ground. No floating parts, no added limbs, no backgrounds, no text or cell borders. Preserve crisp pixel-art style and transparent background.
